changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='review_job'::regclass AND conname='ck_review_job_cancellation'

changeSet.comment: Permit a review job to be cancelled because the sandbox runtime had no room for it in time.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review_job DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_cancellation;

ALTER TABLE review_job ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_job_cancellation CHECK(cancellation_reason IS NULL OR cancellation_reason IN ('DRAIN_GRACEFUL','DRAIN_IMMEDIATE','BUDGET_EXHAUSTED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','MEMBER_AI_DECLINED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','CANCELLED_BY_REQUESTER','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM'));

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='review'::regclass AND conname='ck_review_stop_reason'

changeSet.comment: Permit a review to stop because the sandbox runtime had no room for it in time.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason;

ALTER TABLE review ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason CHECK(stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('TIMED_OUT','EXECUTION_FAILED','PREPARATION_FAILED','PROCESSING_FAILED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','REPLACED','LEGACY_FAILURE','EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE','RESULT_WITHHELD','READINESS_REFUSED','SUSPECT_LISTING','BUDGET','USAGE_UNVERIFIABLE','DEADLINE','CANCELLED','ENUMERATION_FAILED','ENUMERATION_LIMIT','NO_SCAN_PRACTICES','MODEL_CHANGED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','ERROR','LEGACY_SCOPE_UNKNOWN','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM'));
